description:
# Live feed runtime inspection 1.49.0-niconico.10

Adds the optional **Enable feed runtime inspection** patch. Select it together with **Feed layout diagnostics**, then patch the same original YouTube APK with the existing selections. Android debugger attachment is enabled to inspect the actual render metadata and keyed view tags. No new rendering workaround is included. Debuggable builds may run more slowly; omit this patch from normal builds.

The upstream lifecycle backport from .9 remains included. Its effectiveness for the reported symptom has not been established; the user reported no improvement. The earlier speculative width overrides remain removed.
